conclusion: Band 10 (deq_n100a15) GeoTIFF metadata says 'Distance to earthquake', but values peak at 4,962,515 on the Chalfant/Mina/Mammoth seismic swarms, drop to 0 in aseismic northern Nevada, correlate negatively with true distance to live USGS ComCat M>=4.2 epicentres (Spearman = -0.83271), and correlate positively with Band 16 earthquake intensity (Spearman = +0.84048). Band 10 is Earthquake Density (D_eq), not distance; negating it (-deq) inverts active seismic fault zones.
note: Confirms USGS ANSS ComCat FDSN API is reachable and spatially concordant with Official Bands 10 (deq_n100a15) and 16 (ieq_n100a15).
